title: rules.version.retired.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction where a PUBLISHED version is retired: by a newer version taking effect (superseded, actor system), by :retire in single mode, or by :confirm-retire in four-eyes mode (DESIGN section 3.3). The version stays readable for explain and replay. The outbox row id is the event id. Additive changes only within v1.

eventId.description: The event id, a ULID; equal to the outbox row id. Consumers de-duplicate by it.

occurredAt.description: When the state change committed, ISO 8601 UTC.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

correlationId.description: The caller's correlation id (X-Correlation-Id, or the one passed to the Java API). When the caller gave none, the event id: the event starts its own chain.

causationId.description: The id of the command or event that caused this one, or null when a caller's command caused it directly.

producer.description: rule-engine, a slash and the engine version that wrote the event.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the envelope layout; 1 for every .v1 type.

version.description: Version number of the rule set, not the lock version.

retiredBy.description: Who retired it: system when superseded, the confirmer in four-eyes mode, else the caller.

reason.description: SUPERSEDED when superseded, else the reason the caller gave.

supersededBy.description: The version that superseded this one, or null when retired by a command.

retiredAt.description: When the version was retired, ISO 8601 UTC.

noVersionInEffect.description: True when this retirement leaves the rule set with no version in effect (DESIGN section 3.3.4).

approvalMode.description: single for one approver, four-eyes for a confirmed request, system when superseded.
